rules.join: eventId + placeIndex; locationName is a check against accidental mismatches.
rules.visibility: A place is temporally active only when contextOnly is false and at least one inclusive window contains the current year. Otherwise hide it in live mode. Optional context mode may show neutral, non-pulsing background points.

rules.precision: Year windows mean a documented episode occurred during that year, not that it lasted fromJanuary1toDecember31. Multi-year theatre windows do not assert continuous local combat. Never interpolate between disjoint windows.
rules.coordinates: Coordinates inherited from original data are approximate modern anchors and not validated battlefield outlines.
rules.contextOnly: Empty windows deliberately avoid making unsupported yearly claims. Parent event duration is not evidence for every place.
